October 1966 


Better Food for Better Health in Ecuador. Stan 


Susan, new YMCA World Service man in Ecuador, 


watches women volunteers kneed and shape rolls at the 
Chimbicalle Branch of Quito’: 


YMCA. This Branch is 
located in one of the poorest sections of the city. The 
women are members of the YMCA’s Mothers’ Club. 
Twice a week, they come to the Y to make 500 rolls 
for the families of the 100 club members. CARE pro- 


vides the ingredients which are top quality, providing 
nutrients often missing from their diets. A local baker 
donates the use of his d The project is one of sev- 
eral conducted by this self-governing Y club. There are 
classes in literacy, nutrition, and pre-and-post natal 
care. Still less than ten years old, Quito’s YMCA in 
Ecuador is a leader in the field of community develop- 
ment.
